student_directory_by_dept.name: student_directory_by_dept
student_directory_by_dept.body_sql:
SELECT
  `mit_student_directory`.`FULL_NAME` AS `FULL_NAME`,
  `mit_student_directory`.`DEPARTMENT` AS `DEPARTMENT`,
  CHAR_LENGTH(`mit_student_directory`.`FULL_NAME`) AS `full_name_length`
FROM `mit_student_directory`
WHERE `mit_student_directory`.`DEPARTMENT` IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(`mit_student_directory`.`DEPARTMENT`) <> ''
student_directory_by_dept.description: Row-level student directory entries that are assignable to a department code: exposes student identifier, full name, department code and computed full_name_length. Excludes rows with NULL or empty DEPARTMENT (so counting by department is simple).

dept_student_aggregates.name: dept_student_aggregates
dept_student_aggregates.body_sql:
SELECT
  msd.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT,
  COUNT(*) AS student_count,
  MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(msd.FULL_NAME)) AS FULL_NAME
FROM mit_student_directory msd
GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT
dept_student_aggregates.description: Aggregated student measures per department code: student count and maximum full-name length among students whose mit_student_directory.DEPARTMENT equals the department code. Grain matches sis_department.DEPARTMENT_CODE so it can be joined to department metadata.
